book.name: LUKASPA KILLKASHKAN KILLKA
book.title: LUKASPA KILLKASHKAN KILLKA JESUKRISTU RUNAKUNATA KISHPICHISHKANMANTA

content: Jesuska obeha chinkarishkata yuyachishpa yachachin
Jesús yachachihushpan achka runakuna payta kayllayarkakuna uyanankunapa. Shuk runakuna karkakuna romano tukuymanta atun apurayku impuestuta kobrakkuna, shuk mana alita rurakkunapas.
Chayta rikushpankuna fariseokunaka, Moisespa killkashkanta yachachikkunapas washanchashpa rimarkakuna: Kay runaka uchasapakunata yuyashpan paykunawa pakta mikun. Chasnaka mana alichu.
Chaypi Jesuska paykunata shuk yachachinawa kasna yachachirka:
Kankunamanta shukpa tiyama shuk pachak obeha. Shuk chinkarimaka ¿manachu chay iskun chunka iskunta pastupi sakishpan maskak rinma chay shuk chinkarishkata tarinankama?
Tarishpan ¿manachu sumakta kushikushpan apishpan markama?
Chaymanta wasinma paktashpan riksishkankunata, kuchunpi kawsakkunatapas tantachishpan rimama: Kushikuychi ñukawa. Ñami tarishkani chinkarishka obehaynita nishpa.

Kankunata rimanimi: Shuk chinkarishkata tarishpaykichika atunta kushikunkichi. Chasnallatatami silupi kawsakkuna kushikunkakuna, shuk rua mana alita rurashkankunata sakishpan Yaya Diostana kasunanpa. Iskun chunka iskun runakuna alita rurak runa kani yanka nishpa kawsakkunamanta mana yapa kushikunkakunachu.
Jesuska shuk warmi kullkita chinkachishkanta yuyachishpa yachachin
Shuk warmipa chunka kullkikuna tiyamaka. Chay chunka kullkikunamanta shuk chinkaripumaka ¿manachu lamparinta sintichishpan maskama kawitu ukupi sumakta pichashpan tarinankama?
Chasna tarimaka, amigunkunata paypa kuchunpi kawsakkunata kayashpan rimama: Chay kullki chinkaripashkata ñami tarishkani. Chayrayku tukuy kankuna ñukawa pakta sumakta kushikuychi.
Kankunata rimani: Chasnashinami Yaya Diospa angelkunaka kushikunkakuna, shuk runa mana alita rurashkankunata sakishpan Yaya Diostana kasunanpa.
Jesuska shuk yaya musu wawanta llakichishkanta yuyachishpa yachachin
Jesuska shuk yachachinawa yachachishpalla katirka: Shuk kullkiyu runa ishkay wawayu karka.

Washaniru wawanka yayanta rimarka: Yayayni, shuk puncha tukuy kanpa tiyashkanmanta chawpichishpa ñukata wawkinitapas kunaykita kunalla kuway. Chasna rimashpan yayanka tukuy ima charishkanta chawpita kurka karan shuk wawanta.

Manana yapa unaymantachu chay washaniru wawanka tukuy ima tiyashkanta rantichishpan kullkita tantachishpan rirka shuk karu chikan runakunapa allpama. Chaypi mana ali ruranakunata rurashpan kullkinta llampu tukuchirka.
Llampu tukuchishpan chay llaktakunapi kawsak runakunarayku sinchi yarkay paktarka. Chaypi paypas yapa yarkaywa karka.
Chasna kashpan shuk chaypi kawsak runama tapuk rirka payta tarawachinanpa. Chay runaka payta kacharka kuchinkunata kuyrananpa.
Yapa yarkaywa kashpan kuchi mikunata mikunayarka. Chasna munashpanpas nima chayta payta karanayarkakunachu.
Chaypi yuyarirka: Yayaynipa runankunapaka achka mikuna tiyan. Ñukaka kaypi yarkaywa wañuhuni.
Kunalla yayaynima kutishara. Paktashpayni rimak risha: Yayayni, kanmanta anchurishpayni manami alitachu rurashkani. Chaymantapas manami Yaya Diospa munashkantachu rurashpa kawsashkani.
Chayrayku amana yuyawaynachu wawaykitashina. Shuk runaykitashina tarawachiway nishpa.
Chasna yuyarishpan chay musuka yayanma kutirka. Ña paktahushpan yayanka karullapi rikushpan riksirka. Sumakta llakichirka, kallpashpa tinkuk rirka. Wawanta ukllarishpan mucharka.
Chaypi wawanka rimarka: Yayayni, kanta mana alitachu rurashkani. Chaymantapas manami Yaya Diospa munashkantachu rurashpa kawsashkani. Amana yuyawaynachu wawaykitashina nishpa.

Yayanka paypa rimahushkanta mana kasushpan runankunata rimarka: Utkalla suma churarinata apak riychi payta churachinaykichipa. Chasnallatata makinpi anilluta churachiychi, chakinpipas sapatuta churachiychi.
Chaymanta apak riychi wira wakra wawata wañuchinaykichipa, mikuhushpa tukuymanta sumakta kushikunanchipa.
Kay wawaynika wañushka kashkanmantashina kawsarimushka, unay chinkarishkanmanta kunan ña rikurik shamushka. Chasna sumakta kushikushpan atun fiestata rurarkakuna.
Chay fiestata rurahushpankuna puntiru wawanka chakranpi kahurka. Wasima kutimushpan uyarka bombota, kenata, tukuy kushilla kahukkunata.
Chaypi shuk runanta kayashpan tapurka: ¿Ima fiestata rurahunkuna?
Chay runanka aynirka: Wawkikimi kutimushka. Ali paktamushkanrayku yayaykika atun mikunata rurashka, wira wakra wawata wañuchichishka karananpa.
Chasna uyashpan chay wawkinka yapa piñarirka. Mana yaykunayarkachu wasipi. Paktashkanta yachashpan yayanka wasimanta llukshirka payta kayananpa.

Chaypi chay ruku wawanka aynirka: Yayayni, maytukuy watakunata kanta yanapashkani. Kamachishkaykita nima ima uras killashkanichu. Chasna rurashpaynitata nima ima uras kuwashkankichu nima shuk obehastuta kushikushpa amiguynikunawa mikunaynipa.
Kunanka chay shuk kanpa wawaykika mana ali warmikunawa kawsashpan kullkikita llampu tukuchishpan paktamushka. Payraykuka wira wakra wawata wañuchishkanki.
Chasna nishpan yayanka rimarka: Wawaynistu, kanka tukuy urasmi ñukawa kahunki. Tukuy tiyawahushkaka kanpapas kan.
Chay wawkikika wañushkashina kashkanmantami paktamushka. Chinkarishka kashkanmanta paktamushka. Chasna kashpan ¿manachu yapa kushikushpa kay fiestata ruranchima?
